source_locator.description: As the masked figure is being hanged, the rope is cut and Poongavanam runs in.

translation.english_text: [As the masked figure is being hanged, the rope is cut. Poongavanam runs in.]

source_locator.description: Poongavanam removes the cloth covering the face, sees Maappillaithaasar, and cries out.

translation.english_text: [She removes the cloth covering the face. Maappillaithaasar is revealed there.... She cries out.]
What is this? The swami instead of Muthan?... How did this happen?...

Elder!... I will tell you! I know how the swami got changed!... Muthan's friends freed Muthan, stripped off his black clothes, threw them away and ran... Seeing that, the swami immediately put on those clothes himself and stood like Muthan... These soldiers were deceived and, thinking the swami was Muthan—like this—this way—it happened.
notes: The source's deliberately halting ending `இப்படி—இது மாதிரி—நடந்து விட்டது` is preserved rather than smoothed into a more procedural explanation.

translation.english_text: No one need be surprised! This is the end I sought for myself. I have made atonement for my crimes. This is the first and last sacrifice I make for my son! On the earth where Pattinathar, the eighteen Siddhars, and virtuous ascetics lived, I came as a stain; here, I perish! Poongavanam! Poongavanam! Forgive me! Forgive me! All of you, forgive me! Forgive me!...
notes: The Pattinathar / eighteen-Siddhars sequence is translated only as printed; no external religious biography or attribution is added.

source_locator.description: The swami's speech ends and his life ends.

translation.english_text: [The speech ends; the swami's life ends.]
notes: The source's parallel phrasing `பேச்சு முடிகிறது; சாமியாரின் வாழ்க்கை முடிகிறது` is retained rather than expanded into additional death action.
